zh.title: 美國海軍選定 Boeing 承製 F/A-XX　第六代戰機計畫取得合約
zh.summary: Boeing 宣布取得美國海軍 F/A-XX 合約，機型預定接替 F/A-18 Super Hornet。
body: Boeing 於 2026 年 9 月 29 日宣布，美國海軍已授予該公司 F/A-XX 戰機計畫合約。公告僅以數十億美元規模描述金額，未公布精確數字。
F/A-XX 是海軍第六代戰機計畫，預定接替 F/A-18 Super Hornet 機隊。這是計畫承包商獲選，尚非飛機交付或投入服役。
這也是 Boeing 繼 2025 年獲選承製美國空軍 F-47 後，第二項第六代戰機計畫。公司表示，F/A-XX 的技術與計畫細節仍受美國國安及出口法規保密限制。

en.title: U.S. Navy selects Boeing for F/A-XX sixth-generation fighter program
en.summary: Boeing says it has received a multibillion-dollar contract for the Navy’s planned Super Hornet successor.
body: Boeing announced on September 29, 2026 that the U.S. Navy had awarded it the F/A-XX aircraft contract. The company described the award as multibillion-dollar without specifying an exact value.
The sixth-generation fighter is intended to replace the Navy’s F/A-18 Super Hornet fleet. Contractor selection does not constitute aircraft delivery or entry into service.

The award follows Boeing’s selection for the U.S. Air Force’s F-47 program in 2025. Boeing said technical and programmatic details of F/A-XX remain classified under U.S. national security and export laws.

facts.claim: 2026-09-29 announcement of U.S. Navy multibillion-dollar F/A-XX contract; exact value not disclosed.
F/A-XX intended to replace F/A-18 Super Hornet; Boeing also selected for F-47 in 2025.
Technical and programmatic details remain classified.
